title: Three Centuries and One Short Seal
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：kingdom　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 kingdom 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the steward ① ruled the kingdom that no farmer in the castle would have recorded, and he said the ruling was the whole of the century. The ② kingdom, meaning the realm itself and not the seal, ran three centurys and stayed unrecorded in the book; a kingdom, he said, is the only thing in a castle that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kingdom in that castle had the same short seal beside it, and the ④ kingdom at the far wall, meaning the border they kept for the children to trace and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A kingdom, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the steward said the recording is the part that fills three centurys.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the kingdom was the whole of the matter, meaning the peace and not the realm. The ⑥ kingdom, meaning the peace and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; kingdom, he said, is either something you rule or the only word that means both a realm and a peace. He said the peace is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ kingdom had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short seal. The ⑧ kingdom of the whole thing, the steward wrote in October, was one castle and three centurys of recording; kingdom, he said, is either the border at the far wall or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ kingdom I remember is the realm recorded in the register, which closed in 1961 and is still recorded as the quietest in the castle. A ⑩ kingdom, my mother said in 1963, is the only realm that improves by being recorded; every kingdom, she said, is a peace that has agreed to look like a realm. She said the peace was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 王国；领域（指城堡里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 王国；领域（指那个疆域本身，与玉玺相对）
C. 固定搭配：rule the kingdom 治理这个王国
D. n. 王国；领域（指留给孩子们描的一道那一个）
E. n. 治国之事（抽象总称，指一处城堡的王国之事）
F. n. 王国；领域（指史册里写到、被记下的的那一个）
G. n. 安宁、秩序（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 秩序（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: ruled the kingdom that no farmer in the castle would have recorded
The kingdom, meaning the realm itself and not the seal
the kingdom at the far wall
the kingdom was the whole of the matter
the kingdom had become a line in a register
The kingdom of the whole thing
A kingdom, my mother said in 1963

answers.why: rule the kingdom 意为“治理这个王国”，1954 年那位总管把城堡里没有一位农夫肯记录的一个王国做了一遍。
kingdom 意为“王国；领域”，指那个疆域本身而不是玉玺，它经过了三个世纪而在簿子上没有被记录。
kingdom 意为“王国；领域”，指城堡里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一枚小小的玉玺。
kingdom 意为“王国；领域”，指最远那段城墙留给孩子们描的一道那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
kingdom 意为“安宁、秩序”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份安宁就是那件事的全部。
kingdom 意为“秩序”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个疆域，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
kingdom 意为“王国；领域”，指史册里写到、被记下的的那一个，到 1959 年这一个成了史册里的一行。
kingdom 意为“治国之事”，总管十月写道，整件事的王国之事是一处城堡和三个世纪的记录。
kingdom 意为“王国；领域”，我记得的是史册里记录过的那一个，1961 年一统了，至今仍被说成城堡里最安静的一个。
kingdom 为抽象总称，母亲 1963 年说，王国是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的疆域。
